issues.description: Constructor attribute naming mismatch for the query register in Exercise 1. In template_repository/ex1_grover_two_qubit_without_auxiliary_qubit.py the constructor creates the register and assigns it to self._query_register but then constructs the QuantumCircuit with self.query_register (which is undefined) — this occurs at template lines 11-12. In the solution (solution_repository/ex1_grover_two_qubit_without_auxiliary_qubit.py) the constructor consistently uses self.query_register when creating the QuantumRegister and QuantumCircuit (solution lines 11-12). This inconsistent identifier in the template will raise an AttributeError when students instantiate the class or attempt to run the provided template, blocking their ability to begin the exercises.
issues.suggestedFix:
Use a single, consistent attribute name for the query register in the template constructor so later code can reference it. Change the template lines that create/assign the register and build the circuit to use self.query_register (matching the solution). For example:

self.number_of_qubits_query_register = 0  # keep placeholder for students to fill
self.query_register = QuantumRegister(self.number_of_qubits_query_register)
self.qc = QuantumCircuit(self.query_register)

Alternatively, if you prefer the private-name style, use self._query_register consistently in both assignments and whenever the register is referenced. The key is consistency so instantiating the class does not raise AttributeError.
